purpose: Apply the unchanged SINGS-plus-AllWISE fusion to the two final holdout galaxies and produce complete baryonic maps without opening any velocity target.
permittedInputs: P0751A derived holdout baryonic maps, hashes, geometry, and audit
frozen P0740 holdout AllWISE W1 intensity and uncertainty arrays, WCS headers, and coadd IDs
holdout SINGS IRAC channel-1 image and weight arrays for the predeclared cross-calibration
forbiddenInputs: SPARC observed rotation speeds or errors
any gravity-formula residual, score, or fitted parameter

processing.method: Bit-for-bit P0741 fusion implementation generalized only to the holdout split and frozen parent path named here.
processing.wiseTileBackground: robust median in the outer 15 percent border
processing.wiseMosaic: inverse-variance combination of every frozen coadd
processing.wiseForegroundSuppression: same 12-MAD compact-residual rule used by P0741
processing.crossCalibration: median positive SINGS/WISE ratio over the unchanged overlap mask, with fixed quadrant sensitivity audit
processing.fusion: beam-matched SINGS inside its valid footprint and scaled beam-matched WISE outside it
processing.stellarMassCalibration: one normalization to published 3.6 micron luminosity times universal M/L=0.5
processing.gasMassCalibration: retain P0751A normalization to 1.36 times published H I mass

claimBoundary: P0751B is a final-holdout observational fusion test, not a gravity score.
The per-galaxy WISE/SINGS factor is instrument cross-calibration and cannot be chosen from a velocity residual.
The algorithm, parent-config hash, and gates are committed before any holdout image array is opened.
No velocity or dispersion target may be opened in this stage.
